why: Stops checking the toast rail against the inset when the topbar is hidden. With no bar, row 2 of the HUD grid starts at the display edge, so the rail's only protection from a cutout is its own rule; the M-key mute toast on the Main Menu is a real case. Without this, deleting that rule would leave menu toasts under the Dynamic Island and the gate green.
killedBy: topbar clearance verdict (issue #687) fails a menu toast rail inside the inset once no topbar is there to clear it
